text: If a man accuses another man of a crime and cannot prove it, the accuser shall be put to death.
If a man steals the property of a temple or of the court, he shall be put to death.
If a man steals cattle or sheep or an ass or a pig or a goat of a god or of the court, he shall pay thirtyfold.
If a man steals cattle or sheep or an ass or a pig or a goat of a freed man of the king, he shall pay tenfold.
If the thief has nothing to pay with, he shall be put to death.

penalty: be put by man to death
text: If a man sells a lost thing that he found, he is a thief and shall be put to death.
If a man steals the minor son of another man, he shall be put to death.
If a man breaks a hole into a house, he shall be put to death before that hole and be buried.
If a man commits a robbery and is caught, he shall be put to death.
If a man who comes to put out a fire takes the property of the owner of the house, he shall be thrown into that fire.
If a man neglects his dam and the dam breaks and floods the field, he shall replace the corn that he ruined.

penalty: pay twenty gur for ten gan
text: If a shepherd lets the sheep eat the field without the consent of the owner, he shall pay twenty gur of corn for every ten gan.
If a man puts out the eye of a free man, his eye shall be put out.
If a man knocks out the teeth of his equal, his teeth shall be knocked out.
If a builder builds a house badly and the house falls and kills its owner, the builder shall be put to death.
If an ox gores a man while it walks along the street and the man dies, no claim can be made.
If an ox is known to gore and the owner has not bound its horns, and the ox gores a free man and kills him, the owner shall pay one half of a mina.
If the ox kills the slave of a man, the owner shall pay one third of a mina.
If a man steals a water wheel from the field, he shall pay five shekels to its owner.
